yarn-dinkum.meaning: Faithful. "Anyone can earn travel comp time: there are no limits based on salary level or schedule type." slightly broadens the claim, though it echoes the heading "for everyone".

yarn-dinkum.authenticity: Natural Australian office voice: "put in for", "Got questions? Give your Timekeeper ... a shout."
yarn-dinkum.register: A light-to-moderate touch right at level 2: casual restructuring plus "squiz", "put in for", "a shout". There's no swearing.
yarn-dinkum.tone: Friendly, but still a clear policy statement: "Once you hit the expiry date, you forfeit the leave."
yarn-dinkum.flow: Smooth, with the sentences reordered for natural reading: "If you've been approved to travel for work and the travel happens outside regular working hours, you can put in for travel comp time."
yarn-dinkum.variety: Varied, with nothing repeated: "put in for", "squiz", "a shout", "runs out".

yarn-troppo.meaning: All the rules survive, but it adds lines: "so don't get any ideas", "Top of the ladder or bottom, same deal.", "Sitting in traffic on the way is just regular hours, nothing extra, sorry.", "Jot it all down as you go", "So use it or lose it." These are mostly elaborations; the traffic line adds a scenario the original doesn't address.
yarn-troppo.sense: The terms fit: "put in for", "have a squiz", "Sing out to your Timekeeper", "nuts and bolts", "doesn't keep".
yarn-troppo.authenticity: The idiom is natural ("Sing out to", "doesn't keep"), but the openers are stock: "Righto, travel comp time.", "So here's the thing.", "Right, the maths.", "Here's the catch".
yarn-troppo.register: Much heavier than level 2, a chatty walkthrough with added openers and tags throughout. There's no swearing.
yarn-troppo.tone: A policy page made jokey and a little flippant: "so don't get any ideas", "nothing extra, sorry". The rules are still stated clearly.
yarn-troppo.flow: Lively but padded; the openers pile up: "So here's the thing.", "Right, the maths.", "Still scratching your head?"
yarn-troppo.variety: The slang varies, but the paragraph openers lean on one move: "Righto", "Now,", "And", "So here's the thing.", "Right,", "Here's the catch".
yarn-troppo.essence: Recognisably the policy, but its neutral reference voice becomes a pep talk.
